# v0.33.2 verifier upgrade: testnet execution (Sepolia)

Generated by `protocol_ops dev execution-runbook` from [`execution.json`](./execution.json) in this directory, which is the source of truth. Network: Sepolia (chain id 11155111).

- **Sender for all 39 txs:** the testnet owner EOA `0xD64e136566a9E04eb05B30184fF577F52682D182`. It owns the 38 member Safes of the Emergency Upgrade Board.
- **Order:** 3 emergency proposals, one after the other: txs 1 to 12 approve, tx 13 executes; txs 14 to 25 approve, tx 26 executes; txs 27 to 38 approve, tx 39 executes.
